name: Agent Config Guards
description: Mirrors the agent-config repo's Claude Code hard-layer hooks (destructive-exec, write-path, write-existing-file, webfetch-domain, outbound, context re-injection, auto-format, comment-checker, file-read nudge, session-notification) as OpenClaw plugin hooks.

caveman.description: Inject the caveman communication-mode directive into every session's system context. Same effect as OPENCLAW_CAVEMAN=1.

notifyCommand.description: Executable to run for session-end/turn-end desktop notifications, e.g. "notify-send". null disables notifications.

webfetchDenylist.description: Path to a hostname-glob denylist file, one pattern per line. Defaults to $OPENCLAW_WEBFETCH_DENYLIST or ~/.openclaw/webfetch-denylist.txt.

protectedPaths.description: Extra paths (beyond the built-in SSH/GPG/hooks/settings set) that write-path-guard should treat as protected and deny writes to.

workspaceOnlyWrites.description: When true (default), write-path-guard asks for approval on writes outside the workspace/cwd and recognized scratch dirs; when false, it only enforces the hard-denied protected paths.
